statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : E → Space m) (x : E), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → ∀ e : E, fderiv ℝ (fun y => inner ℝ (f y) (f y)) x e = inner ℝ (f x) (fderiv ℝ f x e) + inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ f x e) (f x)
proof:
intro E _ _ f x hf e
exact fderiv_inner_apply ℝ hf hf e
